🇳🇱🆙 #Juventus needs #Koopmeiners: with #Miretti and #Adzic gone and #Thuram out, the midfield would have been left in distress. For this reason, the club put up a wall against his sale. In the final hours of mercato, #Besiktas made an attempt, but the timeframe was too tight to secure a replacement. In August, inquiries had also been made by #Galatasaray, #Monaco and two Premier League clubs, without however convincing either the player or the bianconeri.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🤕⁉️ #McKennie is not at risk: he resumed training and continued his individualized program with the goal of returning on Sunday, but without forcing anything. #Cambiaso, on the other hand, remained sidelined after the blow he took against #Parma: he has a light sprain ankle. #Zhegrova also trained separately yesterday due to a minor overload issue. The conditions of both players should still be monitored.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇽🇰🔚 #Juventus is preparing for the upcoming Europa League without #Zhegrova, who has been excluded from the UEFA squad list. The exclusion is primarily linked to the number of players in the attacking midfield. The management remains available to explore potential offers for his permanent transfer or loan from markets that are still open, particularly Saudi Arabia, Portugal and Turkiye. Otherwise everything can be postponed to January.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

Medical Update | Khephren Thuram and Juan CabalThis morning, Khephren Thuram underwent chondroplasty surgery to treat chondropathy of the patella in his right knee. The procedure, performed by Dr. Bertrand Sonnery-Cottet in the presence of the club’s medical director, Dr. Luca Stefanini, at the Hôpital Privé Jean Mermoz in Lyon, was a complete success, and the player will begin his rehabilitation program tomorrow.Following a muscle issue he experienced during yesterday’s training session, Juan Cabal underwent further diagnostic tests this morning at J|medical. Imaging tests revealed a mild strain of the semimembranosus muscle in his left thigh.[Juventus]
